text: API requests authenticate using an OAuth 2.0 access token tied to a service account
quote: Requests are authenticated with an OAuth 2.0 access token belonging to a service account.

text: Credentials can be rotated with zero downtime by creating a new service account before revoking the old one
quote: To rotate without downtime, create a second service account, move the integration over to it, and revoke the first one once the switch is confirmed.

text: Revoking a service account immediately deletes it and invalidates all its outstanding tokens
quote: Revoke deletes the service account and invalidates its outstanding access tokens right away.

text: Service-account credentials are scoped per integration, short-lived, and revoke instantly, replacing legacy API keys
quote: If you still authenticate with an API key, migrate to a service account: the credentials are scoped per integration, the tokens are short-lived, and revocation takes effect immediately.

text: An auth API operation lets a caller authenticate and fetch basic company information
quote: The auth operation is a basic interface designed for authentication purposes. The operation user can authenticate their credentials and obtain basic company information.

text: A companyCaptable API operation returns cap table data for a specific company
quote: The companyCaptable operation is a Ledgy interface for one specific company. The operation user can retrieve cap table data about the queried company.

text: Historical transaction data can be imported into the cap table with supporting documents attached
quote: Bring historical transaction data into your cap table, with documents attached for maximum visibility and accuracy.

text: Reports can be customized with configurable columns, views, and aggregate grouping
quote: Build reports based on your needs: play with columns and views and aggregate grouping to see your data, your way.

text: Over 70 HRIS integrations keep large volumes of stakeholder data accurate
quote: Leverage the power of 70+ HRIS integrations to keep large volumes of data accurate.

text: Granting, document, and signature workflows can be automated and run in bulk for expansion
quote: Grant share awards one by one, or in bulk, creating, signing and sharing contracts in just a few clicks.

text: Vesting schedules can be switched per group or fully customized to reflect specific needs
quote: Switch up vesting schedules for different groups, or create custom vesting to reflect your needs.

text: Financial reports for IFRS 2, UK GAAP, and US GAAP with tranche-level detail can be generated instantly
quote: Generate a broad suite of financial reports instantly to account for equity under IFRS 2, UK GAAP or US GAAP, with tranche-level details in one click.

text: Automated error flags and visual indicators help identify and resolve compliance risks
quote: Automated error flags and crystal-clear visuals let you easily identify and resolve compliance risks.

text: Global mobility reporting tracks equity and tax implications as employees move across borders
quote: Global mobility reporting helps you stay on top of equity and tax as your workforce moves across borders.

text: Platform connects nominee, broker, and paying agent in one place to streamline global employee share trading
quote: Ledgy connects nominee, broker, and paying agent, all in one place to streamline global employee trading.

text: Direct integration with Airwallex enables global employee payouts in 170 countries and 60+ currencies
quote: Enable global employee payouts thanks to a direct integration with international paying agent, Airwallex. Employees can receive payments in 170 countries, and over 60 currencies
